summary: @dwaynelaf I actually found the @medium export feature very easy to add to my site. Granted I use #IndieWeb stuff so having microformats on export made it a simple task of cutting and pasting each post into a file. Even tried to kind of recreate the vibe publication layout: https://jgregorymcverry.com/opensourceblogging.html
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@dwaynelaf I actually found the @medium export feature very easy to add to my site. Granted I use #IndieWeb stuff so having microformats on export made it a simple task of cutting and pasting each post into a file.

Even tried to kind of recreate the vibe publication layout: https://jgregorymcverry.com/opensourceblogging.html
